title: ctenitis nemophila
intro: Ctenitis nemophila, commonly known as the "Forest Fern", is a species of fern native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as immune system support and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis nemophila include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which contribute to its use in treating infections and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids and sesquiterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
